Year plan

10 sessions, Oct 2026 – Sep 2027

No sessions in March and April 2027

    When & where

    • Second Wednesday of the month, 13:30–15:00 (Bangkok time)
    • SSPO lecture room; some sessions are also on Zoom. Each session's format is announced beforehand.
    • If the date falls on a public holiday, the session moves to the following Wednesday.

    Presenting teams

      Attending

      • Open to SSPO staff, prosthetists and orthotists from other institutions, and alumni.
      • External participants join on Zoom; the link is sent after you register. SSPO staff attend on-site.
      • Announcements and Zoom links go out on the SSPO LINE Official Account (QR code above).
      • No registration fee.
